title: Departures
subtitle: Schedule departures for a trip and set per-departure prices.
noToursBody: Create a trip first — departures attach to a scheduled trip.

availabilityInfo.title: No scheduled departures
availabilityInfo.bodyOnRequest: This trip runs only when a customer requests it, so it carries no departure calendar.
availabilityInfo.bodyCustomQuote: This trip is quoted per request and carries no departure calendar.
availabilityInfo.helper: Pricing still applies — you set the options and prices below.

section.title: Departures
section.helper: One row per scheduled occurrence of this trip.

empty: No departures for this trip yet.

publishedNoOpen.title: This trip is published but has no open departure
publishedNoOpen.body: It stays published but cannot be booked until a departure is open. Cancel the last open departure and add a new one here.

editDialog.title: Edit departure
editDialog.description: Update the schedule, capacity, deadline, notes or status.

fields.deadlineHelper: Optional — how late travelers can book.

confirm.cancelBody: This departure is cancelled one-way and stops being bookable. Cancelled departures keep their data and cannot be re-opened.

fieldErrors.startRequired: Pick a start date and time.
fieldErrors.endRequired: Pick an end date and time.
fieldErrors.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
fieldErrors.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a whole number above 0.
fieldErrors.deadlineAfterStart: The deadline must be on or before the start.
fieldErrors.notesTooLong: Keep notes to 10000 characters or fewer.

errors.tourNotFound: This trip is no longer available.
errors.departureNotFound: This departure is no longer available.
errors.capacityBelowReserved: Capacity can't go below the number of travelers already booked.
errors.hasActiveBookings: This departure has bookings and can't be cancelled.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
